name: complaint-portal
description: Finance Division IT Complaint Portal — NestJS + Prisma backend and Next.js frontend

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names backend,frontend --prefix-colors blue,green "npm run start:dev --workspace=backend" "npm run dev --workspace=frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=backend && npm run build --workspace=frontend
scripts.start: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names backend,frontend --prefix-colors blue,green "npm run start:prod --workspace=backend" "npm run start --workspace=frontend"
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=backend && npm run lint --workspace=frontend
